body: The sight of the drone hovering outside my office made me furious. I felt like yelling at someone who dared to disturb my work environment. But there was also an overwhelming sense of protection. I couldn't bear the thought of seeing that person suffer. So instead, I stepped closer to the window, my hand on the handle as if ready to slam it down at any moment. My heart raced, but it was the soft glow of hope that stayed with me—that this brave soul would be protected, even if they had the nerve to disrupt my day.
